comment: Folded in from github.com/marcfuentes/dustbox-zdl (MIT, (c) 2026 Marcelo Fuentes). DOD FX33 Buzz Box-style distortion plus a flip-flop sub-octave. Dustbox — DOD FX33 Buzz Box clone (renamed off the original branding: vacuum-cleaner theme). A Grunge-style distortion in series with an MXR Blue Box: a gated fuzz plus a synthetic sub-octave two octaves down, generated by a zero-crossing flip-flop divider (like the original CD4013). Chainsaw fuzz with a glitchy square sub. Desktop preview implements the full DSP; the pedal C port is a 1:1 translation of it.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category (matches the rest of this pack; easiest to find on-device). A Drive-category custom may not appear on MS-70CDR without a stock Drive installed.
fxid_comment: 0x01CF. The pack's pedal manifests use 450-462; 463 keeps it unique. Verify before flashing.

params.name: Dust
params.comment: (was Heavy) Blend between the distortion (0) and the sub-octave fuzz (100, 2 octaves down) -- how much low-end 'dust' the box is pulling in. The ONLY knob that adds the octave; at 0 no octave is present. Left-to-right order matches the real FX33's Heavy/Buzz/Saw/Thrust layout.

params.name: Motor
params.comment: (was Buzz) Gain / distortion amount -- how hard the 'motor' is straining. Distortion ONLY -- never adds the octave.

params.name: Filter
params.comment: (was Saw) Tone: single high-shelf. 0 = muffled/clogged filter (dark), 50 = flat, 100 = clear/hissy filter (bright).
